decisions.afbbf6c3: Human chose: IMPLEMENT strictness behavior as an ENFORCEMENT MODULATOR. strict = any violation (warning or error) blocks transitions; loose = current behavior unchanged (only enforced/error rules block); permissive = nothing blocks, all violations report-only. Severity + enforce flags unchanged; strictness is a global gate multiplier.

wave3_status.2c66e9f7: DONE. code-review found the freshness guard was CIRCULAR (compared EventTag::ALL against EventTag's own derived schema), so a new Event variant reusing an existing tag would serialize an uncataloged `type` while compiling.
